name: inspect_pebbling_figure
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,base64,sys
from pathlib import Path
p=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f','10','-l','10','-singlefile','-scale-to','1100','-png','sources/pebbling.pdf'],capture_output=True);assert p.returncode==0
b=base64.b64encode(p.stdout).decode();w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),'figures/pebbling-page10.png','--base64'],input=b,text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
print(b)
